question: Does pol_diam disagreement act as a non-trivial filter that enriches truth-q_a hypotheses in the cached s049 cascade survivor pool (seed 14)?
hypothesis: Rejecting (q_a, omega) hypotheses whose implied pol_diam disagrees with the LC-predicted pol_diam (s055a) is orthogonal to mag-agreement and enriches truth-adjacent hypotheses by >=3x.
narrative_md: Decisive negative: pol_diam disagreement is NOT a useful filter on the s049 cascade pool for seed 14. Best enrichment of truth-q_a hypotheses = 1.24x (K=3 intersect pol_diam at 25% threshold), far below the 3x gate; pol_diam-only is flat (0.87-1.02x). Mechanism: cascade omega from anchor-pair finite-diff has pol_diams set by (q_a,q_b) geometry, not by truth-adjacency, so random q_a reproduce truth-like pol_diams. Closes the last extract-from-cascade-pool hypothesis. Reads truth-q_a labels and truth pol_diam -- oracle-leak, N=1.
